notablePrerequisites: You have a noncreature spell in hand with enough mana to cast it.
description:
Cast any noncreature spell from your hand by paying its mana cost.
Dovescape triggers, exiling the spell, causing you to cast the spell without paying its mana cost, and creating a number of 1/1 Bird creature tokens equal to the spell's mana value.
Repeat step 2.
